recommendations.title: Solar Energy Adoption & LED Grid Upgrade
recommendations.description: Encourage rooftop solar PV installation incentives for commercial hubs and upgrade all street lighting to automated energy-efficient LEDs.

recommendations.title: Sustainable Mobility & Smart Signal Synchronization
recommendations.description: Implement adaptive traffic signal control system, optimize heavy-vehicle access timings, and dedicate lanes for cycling and pedestrian safety.

recommendations.title: Public Solar EV Charging Hubs
recommendations.description: Deploy fast-charging EV stations at commercial parking zones, public parks, and fuel stations with standardized multi-plug compatibility.
